steps.what: Read system performance the record stores.
Determine standards the record does not cover.

tasks.design: The developer reads performance the {OPS_SYSTEM} already stores, then determines the standards, including cases the record does not cover. They note the standards. Nothing sets a standard.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standards were chosen from memory of how the system felt, then written down.
tasks.enabler_now: The operations record can already show the measurements. The standard is still a judgement.
tasks.still_hard: A measurement is not a standard. The developer still has to decide the bar.
tasks.human_edge: The developer determines the standards. The record only shows measurements.
tasks.altitude: The developer still determines the standards. Reading stored measurements is the only part that moves, and it does not set the bar.

reach.task: Read the standards the developer noted
reach.learn: Do not treat a measurement as the standard

evidence.claim: Stored performance measurements can be read. Setting the standard is a judgement and is not the measurement.
EU rules require literacy for a person who uses a system that drafts text or code. A user-facing bot must identify itself as a machine. This design has no bot.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a standard is needed and ends when the developer has noted it. They determine the standard. The record only supplies measurements.

The fields are the measurement and the standard they note. The operations record produces the measurement. The developer produces the standard. If a case has no measurement, they still determine the standard.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the determination stays.
unknowns: Whether the operations record already stores the measurements they need.
Who else must live with the standard once it is noted.
research_questions: Does the operations record already store the measurements they need?
Who else must live with the standard once it is noted?

already_counted.description: The whole step stays with the software developer
The whole step stays with the software developer
The whole step stays with the software developer

incremental.description: Keep the measurement list aligned with the standard they note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the measurements are not stored, the reading stays, and the low end is determining the standards, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult customers on design and maintenance.

steps.what: Read project status before the consult.
Consult customers on software system design.
Consult other departments on technical issues.

tasks.design: The developer reads project status on {PROJECT}, then consults customers and other departments in person. The consult is not recorded. Nothing answers a technical issue for them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status was looked up in a hurry, and the consult itself was the work.
tasks.enabler_now: The project record can show status before the consult. The consult stays a conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Design and maintenance issues are still settled in the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The developer consults. A status screen does not.
tasks.altitude: The consult stays in full. Only reading the stored project status is shorter, and it happens before the conversation.

reach.learn: The consult is not replaced by a status screen

evidence.claim: A customer consult is the work. Reading a stored project status before the conversation does not replace it.

EU data-protection rules limit monitoring of staff to what is necessary and proportionate. National rules on employee monitoring differ. This design does not score a developer and does not record a supervision conversation.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a consult is booked and ends when the conversation is over. The developer consults. The status read is only a preparation.
The fields are the project status. The project record produces the status. The people in the room produce the issues. If the status is blank, they say so in the consult.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the consult stays.
unknowns: Whether project status is already a field.
Whether the customer will attend in person or by call.

Will the customer attend in person or by call?

tasks.short: Confer with project managers on limitations.

steps.what: Confer with project managers on limitations.
Confer on capabilities for processing projects.
Write the limitations information they obtain.

tasks.design: The conference stays in the room. The developer writes the limitations they obtained and accepts that note. {DOCS} files that version. The conference is not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: The conference produced a scribble that was typed into the file later.
tasks.enabler_now: A file can store a limitations note the developer has already written and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: Capabilities and limitations are still said by the managers, not inferred.
tasks.human_edge: The developer confers and accepts the note. The file does not confer.
tasks.altitude: The conference stays in full. Only filing the limitations note they accepted is shorter.

reach.task: Attend the conference on processing limits
reach.learn: The note does not replace the conference

evidence.claim: A conference with project managers is the work. Filing a note the person wrote afterward does not replace it.

EU data-protection rules limit monitoring of staff to what is necessary and proportionate. National rules on employee monitoring differ. This design does not score a developer and does not record a supervision conversation.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the conference is held and ends when the accepted limitations note is on file. The developer confers, then writes the note.
The fields are the limitation and their acceptance. The managers produce the limitation. The developer writes it. If nothing was obtained, nothing is filed.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the conference stays.
unknowns: Whether data-processing limits are named in that conference.
Whether the note may be shared outside the project.
research_questions: Are data-processing limits named in that conference?
May the note be shared outside the project?

steps.what: Display equipment functioning the console already shows.
Ensure the system operates in conformance.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} console already displays equipment functioning. The developer still monitors the system against specifications and ensures conformance. That display is not their labour, and it does not decide conformance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Someone stood and watched a console that was already updating.
tasks.enabler_now: The console already shows functioning. Conformance is still a judgement against the specification.
tasks.still_hard: The developer still has to decide whether what the console shows meets the specification.
tasks.human_edge: The developer monitors and ensures conformance. The console only displays.
tasks.altitude: The developer still monitors the equipment and ensures conformance. Nothing in the monitoring itself is shortened.

reach.task: Read a conformance note if the developer writes one later
reach.learn: The console display is not a conformance decision

evidence.claim: A console that already displays equipment functioning is not saved human labour. Comparing that display with a specification stays with the person.

EU data-protection rules limit monitoring of staff to what is necessary and proportionate. National rules on employee monitoring differ. This design does not score a developer and does not record a supervision conversation.

assumptions: The workflow starts when equipment is running and ends when the developer has ensured conformance. They monitor. The console display is excluded.
The display is produced by the console. The developer produces the conformance judgement. There is no new field.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the monitoring stays. Zero incremental hours are justified because no new tool and no new check are added.
The console share is not the developer's baseline.
unknowns: Whether the console already displays this equipment.
Which specifications define conformance for this system.
research_questions: Does the console already display this equipment?

role.altitude: The developer still sets performance standards, still consults customers, and still confers with project managers. Monitoring stays in person. The console that already displays equipment is not treated as saved labour.
reach: An operations engineer reads standards the developer noted
skills_to_grow: Setting the standard rather than treating a measurement as the bar
Consulting in the room rather than sending a generated answer
Monitoring conformance rather than trusting the console
role.ambitious_version: Every standard is one the developer set, and every conference still happens with them in the room.
